stories.label: Iran crisis — university protests erupt as nuclear ultimatum deadline nears
stories.summary: University students launched anti-regime protests on first day of classes as US strike appears imminent. Simultaneous internal and external pressure on Tehran. Ultimatum deadline ~Feb 23-24. Trump open to 'token' enrichment. Pentagon has strike plans targeting Khamenei.

stories.label: US tariff upheaval — Trump hikes to 15% after Supreme Court strikes down tariffs
stories.summary: Supreme Court struck down IEEPA tariffs 6-3. Trump invoked Section 122 at 10%, then hiked to 15% the next day. Seeking 'legally permissible' alternatives. Constitutional confrontation between branches deepening. Global markets and trade partners scrambling.

stories.label: Five European nations pledge drone defense production using Ukrainian expertise
stories.summary: E5 nations (France, Poland, Germany, UK, Italy) pledge to leverage Ukraine's battlefield drone expertise for low-cost air defense production. Includes 'drone wall' along Russian border. Ukraine becoming defense innovation partner.

stories.label: NASA Artemis II delayed past March over SLS rocket issue
stories.summary: Technical issue with SLS rocket pushes Artemis II from March to at least April. First crewed mission beyond Earth orbit since Apollo 17 continues to face delays. 2028 lunar landing timeline in question.

stories.label: Wikipedia bans Archive.today over DDoS attacks and altered captures
stories.summary: Wikipedia deprecated Archive.today and began removing links after the archiving service conducted DDoS attacks and altered archived web captures. Raises questions about trust in web archives.

stories.label: Philippine senator demands SCS pushback from disputed Thitu Island
stories.summary: Philippine senator visited Thitu Island in the Spratlys to call for deepening defense partnerships and continuous pushback against Chinese encroachment in the South China Sea.

stories.label: Deepest-ever rock core extracted from under Antarctic ice sheet
stories.summary: Scientists extracted the deepest rock core ever drilled through Antarctic ice, providing unprecedented data about conditions at the base. Critical for understanding ice sheet stability and sea level rise projections.

stories.label: Ethiopia-Tigray-Eritrea: Troop movements raise renewed conflict fears
stories.summary: Bloomberg reports military troop movements near Eritrea-Tigray border. 2022 Pretoria peace agreement may be unraveling. Tigray war killed 300-500K people.

stories.label: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire collapse — Hezbollah declares resistance only option
stories.summary: Hezbollah declared 'resistance' the only option after 10+ killed in Israeli strikes. Senior official killed in Bekaa Valley. Ceasefire effectively dead with near-daily Israeli strikes.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia conflict — talks stalled, military escalation continues
stories.summary: Ukraine struck a missile production facility deep inside Russia. Diplomatic talks stalled since third Geneva round. European nations now leveraging Ukrainian drone expertise for defense production.

stories.label: Trump to visit China March 31-April 2 for summit with Xi
stories.summary: White House announces Trump will visit China March 31-April 2. First face-to-face with Xi this term. Now colored by tariff escalation to 15%.

stories.label: China's tech giants recruit AI and semiconductor talent in the US
stories.summary: Chinese tech companies aggressively recruiting AI and semiconductor talent in the US, even as both governments restrict technology flows.

stories.label: EU excludes China from critical tech research programmes
stories.summary: EU excluded Chinese researchers and institutions from AI, semiconductor, and critical tech programmes. Aligns with US containment strategy.

stories.label: DeepMind spinoff unveils 'AlphaFold 4' for drug discovery
stories.summary: Isomorphic Labs released new AI model for full molecular interaction modeling.

stories.label: US scientists organize to protect research from political pressure
stories.summary: At the AAAS annual meeting, the dominant theme is protecting research, data, and institutional independence from political interference.

stories.label: Pakistan NW security crisis — soldiers killed in Bannu suicide attack
stories.summary: Lieutenant colonel and another soldier killed in suicide attack in Bannu, NW Pakistan. Militant attacks surging in the region.

stories.label: India-Brazil critical minerals deal to reduce China dependence
stories.summary: India and Brazil signed critical minerals/rare earths cooperation agreement during Lula's Delhi visit.

stories.label: Venezuela grants amnesty to 379 political prisoners
stories.summary: Venezuela granted amnesty to 379 political prisoners. Fast-track protocol now in place for further releases.

stories.label: Albania clashes as protesters demand PM Rama resign
stories.summary: Violent protests near Albania's parliament. Demonstrators demand Rama resign over corruption.

stories.label: Nigeria Lassa fever outbreak — 22% fatality rate
stories.summary: Lassa fever outbreak in Nigeria at 22% case fatality rate with 15 healthcare workers infected.

stories.label: US to reopen embassy in Syria after 14 years
stories.summary: US State Department notified Congress of intent to reopen Damascus embassy.

stories.label: Sudan genocide and humanitarian crisis
stories.summary: RSF drone killed 3 aid workers. UN crossed genocide threshold. Museveni hosting RSF leader Dagalo for dialogue. Fading from coverage due to no new major developments.

stories.label: Giant tortoises return to Galapagos island after century
stories.summary: 150+ giant tortoises reintroduced to Floreana Island. Decades-long breeding programme success.

stories.label: Thailand election may be voided over barcode blunder
stories.summary: Annulment threat over barcode printing error in ballots. Court ruling expected soon.

stories.label: US ambassador endorses Israeli expansion across Middle East
stories.summary: US ambassador Huckabee told Tucker Carlson it would be 'fine' if Israel expanded from Nile to Euphrates.

stories.label: Saudi-UAE rift over Sudan RSF and Yemen STC
stories.summary: MBS sent detailed complaint to UAE over Emirati support for Sudan's RSF and Yemen's STC.

stories.label: OpenAI flagged school shooter but did not alert police
stories.summary: OpenAI flagged shooter's account months before Canadian school shooting but chose not to alert police.
